patterns.name: Go service has auth on HTTP but not WebSocket or gRPC
patterns.description: HTTP routes in this Go project apply authentication middleware, but WebSocket upgrade handlers or gRPC service registrations do not. This is the #1 structural auth gap AI agents introduce: auth is added to REST endpoints and skipped on other transports. WebSocket and gRPC connections carry the same risk surface as HTTP.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks auth that HTTP routes in this project enforce. All transports sharing the same data and business logic must enforce the same authentication requirements.

patterns.name: Node.js service has auth on HTTP routes but not WebSocket or gRPC handlers
patterns.description: HTTP routes in this TypeScript/Node.js project apply authentication, but WebSocket or gRPC handlers do not. Agents commonly wire Express/Fastify auth middleware to REST routes and forget socket.io, ws, or gRPC handlers that access the same data.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks auth that HTTP routes in this project enforce. WebSocket and gRPC connections carry equivalent risk and must apply the same authentication.

patterns.name: Node.js service has auth on HTTP routes but not WebSocket or gRPC handlers
patterns.description: HTTP routes in this JavaScript/Node.js project apply authentication, but WebSocket or gRPC handlers do not. Agents commonly wire Express/Fastify auth middleware to REST routes and forget socket.io, ws, or gRPC handlers that access the same data.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks auth that HTTP routes in this project enforce. WebSocket and gRPC connections carry equivalent risk and must apply the same authentication.

patterns.name: Python service has auth on HTTP endpoints but not WebSocket or gRPC handlers
patterns.description: HTTP endpoints in this Python service apply authentication (FastAPI Depends, Django @login_required, Flask @login_required), but WebSocket endpoints or gRPC service methods do not. WebSocket connections in FastAPI and Django Channels carry the same user-data access risk as REST endpoints.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks the authentication that HTTP endpoints in this service enforce. WebSocket connections and gRPC calls access the same data and must require authentication.

patterns.name: Java service has auth on HTTP controllers but not WebSocket or gRPC handlers
patterns.description: HTTP controllers in this Java service apply security annotations (@PreAuthorize, @Secured, @RolesAllowed) or Spring Security filters, but WebSocket message handlers or gRPC service implementations do not. Spring WebSocket and gRPC services require explicit security configuration separate from the HTTP security filter chain.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks the security configuration that HTTP controllers in this service enforce. Spring WebSocket and gRPC handlers are outside the standard HTTP security filter chain and require explicit authentication checks.

patterns.name: Rust service has auth on HTTP routes but not WebSocket or gRPC handlers
patterns.description: HTTP routes in this Rust service apply authentication middleware (.wrap(auth) for actix-web, .layer(auth) for Axum), but WebSocket upgrade handlers or tonic gRPC service registrations do not. Axum WebSocket handlers and tonic gRPC services have independent middleware stacks that must be configured separately from HTTP routes.
patterns.message: The {target} handler at {file} lacks the auth middleware that HTTP routes in this Rust service enforce. Axum and actix-web WebSocket and gRPC handlers use independent middleware stacks — auth must be applied explicitly to each.
